name: MLOptic Corp.
summary: MLOptic Corp. operates as a precision optical solutions company in China and internationally. The company also focuses on the research and development of precision optical components, lenses, and systems. It offers optical components, modules, engines, and metrology solutions, including spherical and aspherical lenses, cylindrical lenses, freeforms, prisms, waveplates, filters, reticles, mirrors, bonded optics, DOE(CGH); machine vision and LIDAR lens; OCT and intraoral scanning modules; life science optical engines; AOI microscope system; advanced optical testing jigs; and AR metrology solutions.
